data.explanation: This is an invoice from a chimney/flue technician for renovation work done at your property. You need to pay the total amount of €1,785.60 by the deadline shown, which is calculated as 14 days from the invoice date. No discount applies if you pay late ("ohne Abzug"). The invoice does not mention any late-payment penalty, but it's good practice to pay on time to avoid a reminder (Mahnung). Keep this invoice, as craftsman costs for home repairs (Handwerkerleistungen) can often be claimed in your German tax return — check with a tax advisor if unsure.
